items.title: 5 must-read analyst questions from IDEX’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: IDEX’s third quarter saw notable gains, with revenue and adjusted earnings surpassing Wall Street’s expectations. Management credited the outperformance to continued strength in data centers, semiconductors, space and defense, and municipal water markets. CEO Eric Ashleman emphasized that these “advantaged markets” benefited from deliberate capital deployment and integration of acquired businesses, while increased orders across all segments signaled broad-based demand.
